/* POKEMON TORRE V35.9 — 8 DIREÇÕES + GOLPES FORTES CORRIGIDOS
 * PMDCollab sprite-sheet order: 0 S, 1 SE, 2 E, 3 NE, 4 N, 5 NW, 6 W, 7 SW.
 * Direction is taken from true movement in the arena; Attack faces its target.
 * No more fixed row 4 (back pose) while idle. */
function v354Dir8(dx,dy){
 if(!Number.isFinite(dx)||!Number.isFinite(dy)||Math.hypot(dx,dy)<.01)return 0;
 return ((Math.round(Math.atan2(dx,dy)/(Math.PI/4))%8)+8)%8;

function v354DirectionalRow(actor,isEnemy,opponent,now,action,moving,rows){

 // Keyboard / joystick input includes 8 diagonals; core drawMon observes this frame.
 if(isPlayer&&engineNow){
  const keys=engineNow.keys||new Set(),joy=engineNow.input||{dx:0,dy:0};
  const kx=(keys.has('d')||keys.has('arrowright')?1:0)-(keys.has('a')||keys.has('arrowleft')?1:0);
  const ky=(keys.has('s')||keys.has('arrowdown')?1:0)-(keys.has('w')||keys.has('arrowup')?1:0);

  actor.v354Direction=v354Dir8(dx,dy);actor.v354DirectionAt=now;

  const ax=(opponent?.x??actor.x)-actor.x,ay=(opponent?.y??actor.y)-actor.y;
  if(Math.hypot(ax,ay)>1)actor.v354Direction=v354Dir8(ax,ay);

 if(action==='Idle' && (!actor.v354DirectionAt || now-actor.v354DirectionAt>1600)){
  const ax=(opponent?.x??actor.x)-actor.x,ay=(opponent?.y??actor.y)-actor.y;
  actor.v354Direction=isEnemy?v354Dir8(ax,ay):0;
 }
 const row=actor.v354Direction??0;

 if(engineNow){engineNow.v354Directions??={player:0,enemy:0};engineNow.v354Directions[isEnemy?'enemy':'player']=row;}

 if(!b?.active||b.paused||!this.running||m.hp<=0||i<0||i>3)return false;

 if(b.energy<(s.cost||0)){log('Energia insuficiente para '+s.name+'.');return false;}

 const fx=begin(this,s,fire?'fire':'leaves',now,from,to,{v354Special:fire?'fireblast':'petaldance'});
 fx.end=now+(fire?1230:1490);
 this.v354SpecialAttacks||=[];

  hitAt:fire?[now+730]:[now+530,now+860,now+1190],done:0,fx});

const v354OldUpdate=BattleEngine.prototype.update;
BattleEngine.prototype.update=function(dt,now){

 if(!battle?.active)return res;
 this.v354SpecialAttacks=(this.v354SpecialAttacks||[]).filter(c=>{
  if(c.battle!==battle||current()!==c.attacker||foe()!==c.target||c.target.hp<=0)return false;
  while(c.done<c.hitAt.length && now>=c.hitAt[c.done]){
   if(this.enemy?.inv>0 && now-c.hitAt[c.done]<540)break;
   const before=c.target.hp;
   this.hitTarget('enemy',c.move.type,c.fire?c.move.power:Math.max(14,Math.round(c.move.power*.47)));
   c.done++;
   if(c.target.hp<before){

   }

  }
  return c.done<c.hitAt.length && now-c.at<2200 && foe()===c.target;

};

    const a=Math.PI*j*2/5+Math.PI/2+t*.35;

 action:{player:engine?.player?._lastAction,enemy:engine?.enemy?._lastAction},
 lastMove:engine?.v354LastMove||null,specialCasts:engine?.v354SpecialCastCount||0,

/* V35.60 — Progressao real do catalogo e bloqueio por nivel. Nenhum efeito visual de golpe e alterado. */
(function(){
 const previousCatalog=v32Catalogue;
 const firstSkills=v32BaseSkills;
 const minByPower=p=>p<=20?1:p<=30?5:p<=35?12:p<=40?19:p<=45?27:p<=50?35:p<=55?43:p<=60?52:p<=70?63:74;
 function required(entry){
   const m=entry.move||{},power=Math.max(0,Number(m.power)||0),min=Number(entry.level)||1;
   let level=power?minByPower(power):((m.kind==='recover'||m.kind==='hazard')?26:((Number(m.cost)||0)>=28?17:5));
   if(m.kind==='homing')level=Math.max(level,33);
   if(m.kind==='area'&&power>30)level=Math.max(level,21);
   if(m.kind==='beam'&&power>40)level=Math.max(level,32);
   // A trilha de nivel ja existente e respeitada, mas um golpe forte nao cai para Nv.1.
   return Math.min(100,Math.max(min,level));
 }
 function ensureBasic(pool,m){
   let choices=pool.filter(x=>x.available);
   if(choices.length>=4)return pool;
   const home=firstSkills(m),t=D[m.id].type;
   const make=(name,type,power,kind,cost,icon)=>({name,type,power,kind,cost,icon,cat:power?'physical':'status',cd:kind==='shield'?4700:kind==='dash'?1500:2300});
   const options=[
      home[0],
      make('Investida','normal',18,'dash',0,'✹'),
      make('Arranhão','normal',19,'dash',0,'✷'),
      make('Concentrar','normal',0,'shield',14,'✧'),
      make('Golpe Inicial',t,22,'bolt',12,V32_ADD_MOVES[t]?.icon||'✦')
   ];
   for(const move of options){
      if(pool.filter(x=>x.available).length>=4)break;
      if(!move?.name)continue;
      const key=v32MoveKey(move);
      if(pool.some(x=>x.key===key)){
        // Preserve existing entries; only the first elementary move can unlock early.
        const found=pool.find(x=>x.key===key);
        if(found && (move.name==='Investida'||move.name==='Arranhão'||move.name==='Concentrar'||move.name==='Golpe Inicial')){found.level=1;found.tm=false;found.available=true;}
        continue;
      }
      pool.push({key,move:{...move},level:1,tm:false,available:true});
   }
   return pool;
 }
 let catalogCount=0,blockedAt5=0,adjustedSaves=0;
 v32Catalogue=function(m){
   const pool=previousCatalog(m);
   if(!m||!D[m.id])return pool;
   const level=Math.max(1,Math.floor(Number(m.level)||1));
   for(const x of pool){
     if(!x?.move)continue;
     x.level=required(x);
     const tms=Array.isArray(save.v32?.tms)?save.v32.tms:[];
     x.available=level>=x.level && (!x.tm||tms.includes(x.move.type));
   }
   if(Number(m.id)===105 && !pool.some(x=>x.move.name==='Focus Energy')){
     const fm={name:'Focus Energy',type:'normal',kind:'shield',cat:'status',power:0,cost:21,cd:6100,icon:'◎'};
     pool.push({key:v32MoveKey(fm),move:fm,level:12,tm:false,available:level>=12});
   }
   ensureBasic(pool,m);
   pool.sort((a,b)=>a.level-b.level||a.move.name.localeCompare(b.move.name,'pt-BR'));
   if(level<8){
      const available=pool.filter(x=>x.available);
      if(available.length>4){
        const typed=available.find(x=>x.move.type===D[m.id].type && Number(x.move.power)>0 && Number(x.move.power)<=30);
        const kept=new Set(); if(typed)kept.add(typed.key);
        for(const x of available){if(kept.size>=4)break;kept.add(x.key);}
        for(const x of available){if(!kept.has(x.key)){x.level=Math.max(x.level,8);x.available=false;}}
      }
   }
   if(level<=5)blockedAt5=pool.filter(x=>!x.available).length;
   catalogCount++;
   return pool;
 };
 function pickFour(m,pool){
   const available=pool.filter(x=>x.available),set=new Set(),out=[];
   const legacy=(Number(m.id)===105 && Number(m.level)>=52 && !Array.isArray(m.v32Slots) && typeof window.PokemonTorreV3560PreferredLegacy==='function') ? window.PokemonTorreV3560PreferredLegacy(m) : null;
   const base=Array.isArray(legacy)?legacy:firstSkills(m);
   for(const original of base){
     const candidate=available.find(x=>x.move.name===original.name&&!set.has(x.key));
     if(candidate){out.push(candidate);set.add(candidate.key);}
   }
   for(const candidate of available){if(out.length>=4)break;if(!set.has(candidate.key)){out.push(candidate);set.add(candidate.key);}}
   while(out.length<4 && available.length)out.push(available[out.length%available.length]);
   return out.slice(0,4);
 }
 v32DefaultSlots=function(m){return pickFour(m,v32Catalogue(m)).map(x=>x.key);};
 // Corrige configuracoes antigas que tinham golpes de nivel alto equipados em Nv.5.
 const previousSkill=skillSet;
 skillSet=function(m){
   if(!m||!D[m.id])return previousSkill(m);
   const pool=v32Catalogue(m),defaults=pickFour(m,pool);
   const saved=Array.isArray(m.v32Slots)&&m.v32Slots.length===4?m.v32Slots:null;
   const used=new Set();let changed=false;
   const slots=Array.from({length:4},(_,i)=>{
     let match=saved&&pool.find(x=>x.key===saved[i]&&x.available&&!used.has(x.key));
     if(!match){ match=defaults.find(x=>!used.has(x.key))||defaults[i];if(saved)changed=true; }
     if(match)used.add(match.key);
     return match;
   });
   if(saved&&changed){m.v32Slots=slots.map(x=>x.key);adjustedSaves++; if(adjustedSaves<25)persist();}
   return slots.map(x=>({...x.move}));
 };
 window.PokemonTorreV3560SafeSkills=skillSet;
 window.PokemonTorreV3560LevelDiagnostics=()=>({lowLevelBlocked:blockedAt5,callCount:catalogCount,adjustedSaves,trial:{lv5:v32Catalogue({id:105,level:5}).filter(x=>x.available).map(x=>x.move.name),lv50:v32Catalogue({id:105,level:50}).filter(x=>x.available).map(x=>x.move.name)}});
})();

/* V35.60 — Torre Infinita pos-Liga, chefe a cada 5 andares, recompensa salva. */
(function(){
 const oldMenu=v32TowerMenu,oldStart=v32StartTower,oldFinish=finishBattle;
 let bosses=0,bonusPayouts=0;
 v32TowerMenu=function(){
   if(battle?.active)return;
   if(save.gym<13){overlay('<div class="v32TowerCard"><h2>♾️ Torre Infinita</h2><p class="desc">Desbloqueie a Torre depois de vencer o campeão da Liga. Seu progresso nos ginásios continua salvo.</p><button class="btn gold wide" id="v3560TowerBack">Entendi</button></div>');
     const btn=document.getElementById('v3560TowerBack');if(btn)btn.onclick=()=>{close();render()};return;
   }
   oldMenu();
   const card=document.querySelector('.v32TowerCard');
   if(card){const desc=card.querySelector('.desc');if(desc)desc.textContent='Andares progressivos com chefes a cada 5 batalhas. Conquiste recordes, moedas e superpoções. Em caso de derrota, mantenha a equipe e as capturas.';}
 };
 v32StartTower=function(){
   if(save.gym<13)return v32TowerMenu();
   if(!requireTeam())return showItems();
   const floor=save.v32.tower.floor;
   if(floor%5!==0)return oldStart();
   const ids=[68,94,130,143,149,65,105,150];
   const lv=Math.max(5,Math.min(100,11+floor*2));
   const chosen=[ids[Math.floor(floor/5)%ids.length],ids[(Math.floor(floor/5)+2)%ids.length],ids[(Math.floor(floor/5)+4)%ids.length]];
   const enemies=chosen.map((id,i)=>mon(id,Math.min(100,lv+i)));
   startBattle(enemies,'♛ TORRE INFINITA · ANDAR '+floor+' · CHEFE',false);
   if(battle?.active){battle.v32Mode='tower';battle.v32Floor=floor;bosses++;}
 };
 finishBattle=function(win){
   const tower=!!battle?.active && battle.v32Mode==='tower',floor=tower?battle.v32Floor:0;
   const result=oldFinish.call(this,win);
   if(tower && win && floor%5===0 && floor%10!==0){
     save.coins+=90+Math.min(210,floor*5);
     save.superPotions=(save.superPotions||0)+1;
     persist();bonusPayouts++;
     const notice=document.querySelector('.result');if(notice)notice.textContent+=' · BÔNUS DE CHEFE!';
   }
   return result;
 };
 window.PokemonTorreV3560TowerDiagnostics=()=>({unlocked:save.gym>=13,info:{...save.v32.tower},bosses,bonusPayouts,interval:5});
})();

/* V35.63 — Torre: fichas de recompensa, desafio e loja específica. */
(function(){
 const oldMenu=v32TowerMenu,oldStart=v32StartTower,oldFinish=finishBattle;
 let victories=0,purchases=0;
 function state(){
  if(!save.v3563Tower || typeof save.v3563Tower!=='object') save.v3563Tower={tokens:0,best:0,challenge:'normal',history:[],potsUsed:0};
  return save.v3563Tower;
 }
 const challengeLabels={normal:'Normal',semcura:'Sem poções (+2 fichas)',veloz:'Vitória rápida (+1 ficha)'};
 v32TowerMenu=function(){
  const ret=oldMenu.apply(this,arguments);
  if(battle?.active||save.gym<13)return ret;
  const el=document.querySelector('.v32TowerCard');if(!el)return ret;
  const s=state();s.best=Math.max(s.best,save.v32?.tower?.best||0);
  const panel=document.createElement('section');panel.className='v3563TowerPanel';
  panel.innerHTML=`<h3>🎖️ Recompensas da Torre</h3><p>🪙 Fichas: <b>${s.tokens}</b> · Recorde: <b>${s.best}</b> · Vitórias registradas: <b>${s.history.length}</b></p><label>Desafio da próxima batalha <select id="v3563Challenge"><option value="normal">Normal</option><option value="semcura">Sem poções (+2 fichas)</option><option value="veloz">Vitória rápida (+1 ficha)</option></select></label><div class="v3563TowerActions"><button type="button" class="btn tiny" id="v3563BuyPotion" ${s.tokens<4?'disabled':''}>4 fichas · Superpoção</button><button type="button" class="btn tiny" id="v3563BuyBalls" ${s.tokens<3?'disabled':''}>3 fichas · 3 Pokébolas</button></div><p class="desc">Chefes a cada 5 andares, histórico e recompensas extras. Nenhum item de combate exclusivo altera golpes.</p>`;
  el.appendChild(panel);
  const pick=panel.querySelector('#v3563Challenge');pick.value=s.challenge||'normal';pick.onchange=()=>{s.challenge=pick.value;persist()};
  panel.querySelector('#v3563BuyPotion').onclick=()=>{if(state().tokens<4)return;s.tokens-=4;save.superPotions=(save.superPotions||0)+1;purchases++;persist();v32TowerMenu()};
  panel.querySelector('#v3563BuyBalls').onclick=()=>{if(state().tokens<3)return;s.tokens-=3;save.balls=(save.balls||0)+3;purchases++;persist();v32TowerMenu()};
  return ret;
 };
 v32StartTower=function(){const s=state(),floor=save.v32.tower.floor;const result=oldStart.apply(this,arguments);
  if(battle?.active&&battle.v32Mode==='tower'){battle.v3563Challenge=s.challenge||'normal';battle.v3563PotionStart=s.potsUsed||0;battle.v3563StartAt=performance.now();battle.v3563Floor=floor;}
  return result;
 };
 const potionPrev=battlePotion,superPrev=battleSuperPotion;
 battlePotion=function(){if(battle?.active&&battle.v32Mode==='tower')state().potsUsed++;return potionPrev.apply(this,arguments)};
 battleSuperPotion=function(){if(battle?.active&&battle.v32Mode==='tower')state().potsUsed++;return superPrev.apply(this,arguments)};
 finishBattle=function(win){
  const isTower=!!battle?.active&&battle.v32Mode==='tower';
  const floor=isTower?battle.v3563Floor||battle.v32Floor:0;
  const mode=isTower?battle.v3563Challenge||'normal':'normal';
  const time=isTower?(performance.now()-(battle.v3563StartAt||performance.now())):0;
  const potionStart=isTower?battle.v3563PotionStart||0:0;
  const result=oldFinish.call(this,win);
  if(isTower&&win){
    const s=state(),challBonus=mode==='semcura'&&s.potsUsed===potionStart?2:mode==='veloz'&&time<60000?1:0;
    const earned=1+ (floor%5===0?4:0)+challBonus;
    s.tokens+=earned;s.best=Math.max(s.best,floor);s.history.unshift({floor,earned,mode,at:Date.now()});s.history=s.history.slice(0,35);
    victories++;persist();
    const notice=document.querySelector('.result');if(notice)notice.insertAdjacentHTML('afterend',`<p class="v3563Reward">🎖️ +${earned} fichas da Torre · Total ${s.tokens}</p>`);
  }
  return result;
 };
 window.PokemonTorreV3563TowerDiagnostics=()=>({record:state().best,tokens:state().tokens,victories,purchases,challenge:state().challenge,floor:save.v32.tower.floor});
})();

/* V35.63 — Fichas de Pokémon e prévia de níveis usando catálogo existente. */
(function(){
 const oldTeam=showTeam,oldScreen=v32MoveScreen;
 let opened=0;
 function profile(m){
  if(!m||!D[m.id]||battle?.active)return;
  const d=D[m.id],lv=Math.max(1,Number(m.level)||1),pool=v32Catalogue(m);
  const unlocked=pool.filter(x=>x.available).length;
  const next=pool.filter(x=>!x.available&&!x.tm&&x.level>lv).sort((a,b)=>a.level-b.level).slice(0,6);
  const types=[d.type,d.type2].filter(Boolean);
  const incoming=Object.keys(EFFECT||{}).map(k=>({name:TYPE_NAME[k]||k,mult:types.reduce((v,t)=>v*(EFFECT[k]?.[t]??1),1)}));
  const weaknesses=incoming.filter(x=>x.mult>1).sort((a,b)=>b.mult-a.mult).slice(0,7);
  const resist=incoming.filter(x=>x.mult<1).sort((a,b)=>a.mult-b.mult).slice(0,7);
  const base={pv:d.hp||50,ataque:d.atk||d.attack||50,defesa:d.def||d.defense||50,velocidade:d.speed||d.spd||50};
  const levels=Object.entries(base).map(([k,v])=>`<div class="v3563Stat"><span>${k.toUpperCase()}</span><div><i style="width:${Math.max(6,Math.min(100,v/160*100))}%"></i></div><strong>${v}</strong></div>`).join('');
  const badges=(arr)=>arr.length?arr.map(x=>`<span class="v3563TypeBadge">${x.name} ×${x.mult.toFixed(2)}</span>`).join(''):'Nenhum';
  const xp=Math.max(0,Number(m.xp)||0);
  const rank=(save.v3563UseCounts||{})[m.id]||{};
  const mastery=Object.entries(rank).sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]).slice(0,5);
  overlay(`<div class="sectionhead"><div class="overline">FICHA COMPLETA · ${String(m.id).padStart(3,'0')}</div><button class="btn tiny ghost" id="v3563ProfileBack">✕ Voltar</button></div><div class="v3563ProfileTop">${img(m.id)}<div><h2>${d.name} · Nv. ${lv}</h2><p>${types.map(t=>TYPE_NAME[t]||t).join(' / ')} · ${Math.ceil(m.hp)} / ${m.maxHp} PV</p><p>Experiência registrada: ${xp}</p></div></div><h3>Atributos base</h3>${levels}<div class="v3563ProfileCols"><section><h3>Fraquezas</h3>${badges(weaknesses)}</section><section><h3>Resistências e imunidades</h3>${badges(resist)}</section></div><h3>Golpes: ${unlocked} liberados</h3><p class="desc">Próximos desbloqueios:</p>${next.length?next.map(x=>`<div class="v3563Next">Nv. ${x.level} · ${x.move.name} <small>${x.move.power||0} força</small></div>`).join(''):'Nenhum novo golpe por nível no catálogo atual.'}<h3>Maestria de uso</h3><p class="desc">Bônus moderado de até 6% de dano, desbloqueado com prática e nível.</p>${mastery.length?mastery.map(([n,c])=>`<div class="v3563Next">${n} · ${c} usos</div>`).join(''):'Nenhum golpe registrado ainda.'}<div class="actionRow"><button class="btn gold" id="v3563ProfileSkills">🧠 Trocar golpes</button><button class="btn ghost" id="v3563ProfileClose">Voltar</button></div>`);
  $('v3563ProfileBack').onclick=()=>showTeam();$('v3563ProfileClose').onclick=()=>showTeam();$('v3563ProfileSkills').onclick=()=>v32MoveScreen(m);
  opened++;
 }
 showTeam=function(){const res=oldTeam.apply(this,arguments);if(battle?.active)return res;
  const monsters=[...save.team,...save.box];
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-team]').forEach(row=>{
   const m=monsters[Number(row.dataset.team)];if(!m)return;
   const b=document.createElement('button');b.type='button';b.className='v32SwapBtn v3563ProfileBtn';b.textContent='📋 Ficha · Atributos · Próximos golpes';b.onclick=()=>profile(m);
   const below=row.nextElementSibling;
   if(below&&below.classList.contains('v32SwapBtn'))below.insertAdjacentElement('afterend',b);else row.insertAdjacentElement('afterend',b);
  });return res;
 };

/* V35.66 — Exclusivo Mewtwo de testes: catalogo completo, sem liberar niveis de outros. */
(function(){
 'use strict';
 const PREV_CATALOG=v32Catalogue;
 const PREV_RENDER=render;
 const PREV_TEAM=showTeam;
 const TEST_FIELD='v3566MewtwoTest';
 let cache=null, builds=0, gifted=0; const warnings=[];
 const tester=m=>!!m&&Number(m.id)===150&&m[TEST_FIELD]===true;
 function allMoves(){
   if(cache)return cache;
   if(typeof v32Ensure==='function')v32Ensure();
   const map=new Map();
   for(let id=1;id<=151;id++){
     const p=D[id];if(!p)continue;
     let all=[];
     try{all=PREV_CATALOG({id,level:100,maxHp:100,hp:100,xp:0})||[];}catch(err){if(warnings.length<5)warnings.push({id,error:String(err)});console.warn('Catalogo de teste:',id,err);}
     for(const entry of all){
       if(!entry?.move?.name||!entry.move.type)continue;
       const key=v32MoveKey(entry.move);
       if(!map.has(key))map.set(key,{key,move:{...entry.move},level:1,tm:false,available:true});
     }
   }
   cache=[...map.values()].sort((a,b)=>a.move.type.localeCompare(b.move.type)||a.move.name.localeCompare(b.move.name,'pt-BR'));
   builds++;
   return cache;
 }
 v32Catalogue=function(m){
   if(!tester(m))return PREV_CATALOG(m);
   return allMoves();
 };
 function giveTester(){
   if(!save||!Array.isArray(save.team)||!save.team.length||!save.team[0]?.id)return false;
   if([...save.team,...(save.box||[])].some(tester))return false;
   const m=mon(150,50);m[TEST_FIELD]=true;
   // Apenas quatro slots equipados por vez, mas todos os golpes estao no editor.
   // Nao utiliza a lista de nivel do treinador nem altera a progressao de outros.
   const all=allMoves();
   const preferred=['Psíquico','Confusion','Lança-Chamas','Telecinese','Raio Solar'];
   const selected=[];
   for(const name of preferred){const item=all.find(x=>x.move.name===name&&!selected.includes(x.key));if(item)selected.push(item.key);if(selected.length>=4)break;}
   for(const row of all){if(selected.length>=4)break;if(!selected.includes(row.key))selected.push(row.key);}
   m.v32Slots=selected;
   if(save.team.length<6)save.team.push(m);else{save.box=save.box||[];save.box.push(m);}
   save.v3566TesterGranted=true; gifted++;
   persist();
   return true;
 }
 function labels(){
   document.querySelectorAll('.moncard').forEach((card,i)=>{
      if(!tester(save.team[i]))return;
      const title=card.querySelector('strong');if(title)title.textContent='Mewtwo · TESTE';
      if(!card.querySelector('.v3566TrialLabel')){
        const span=document.createElement('small');span.className='v3566TrialLabel';span.textContent='🧪 Todos os golpes';
        card.insertBefore(span,card.querySelector('.life'));
      }
   });
 }
 render=function(){
   giveTester();
   const r=PREV_RENDER.apply(this,arguments);
   labels();
   return r;
 };
 showTeam=function(){
   giveTester();
   const r=PREV_TEAM.apply(this,arguments);
   if(!battle?.active){
     const testerEntry=[...(save.team||[]),...(save.box||[])].find(tester);
     const editor=document.querySelector('#modal .sectionhead');
     if(testerEntry&&editor&&!document.querySelector('#v3566Hint')){
       const p=document.createElement('p');p.id='v3566Hint';p.className='desc';
       p.textContent='🧪 Mewtwo Nv. 50 de teste: pode equipar qualquer golpe na Central de Golpes. Os demais Pokémon continuam limitados pelo nível.';
       editor.insertAdjacentElement('afterend',p);
     }
   }
   return r;
 };
 const style=document.createElement('style');style.id='v3566TestStyle';
